results.question: Can you tell me about AI Filmmaking?
results.actualReply: AI filmmaking creates cinematic films, commercials, and social media videos by enhancing real hotel or property footage with AI to tell a guest journey story that includes arrival, stay, cuisine, experience, and brand identity without replacing the actual location. This approach begins with the actual property and uses AI for cinematic mood enhancements, story expansion, and multiple content outputs from one shoot, focusing on hospitality understanding and visual storytelling. AI filmmaking workflows include brand discovery, storyboard planning, filming real property assets, AI-enhanced production, editing, and producing final commercial and social media content across platforms.
